Bhuvneshwar Kumar recalled to India T20I squad after four years

Bhuvneshwar Kumar was recalled to India’s Twenty‑20 International squad after an absence of nearly four years, with fast‑bowling all‑rounder Ajit Agarkar no longer in the squad. The surprise selection has been described by some commentators as a possible audition for the 2027 World Cup, and a former India cricketer praised the move, calling the recall long‑awaited and expressing joy.
